5 تهبّش : see 1, in three places. ＝
-A2- Also, and ↓ اهتبش , It became collected; or it collected itself: or the former, it became collected, or it collected itself, from several places: syns. تَجَمَّعَ and إِجْتَمَعَ. (K.) And تهبّش القَوْمُ The company of men became collected as an army, or a military force; or collected itself into an army, or a military force. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
